note: Both sets capture the nine Table 5-1 properties with correct values, units and supporting quotes, and both duplicate the rated rotor speed under two attribute names. Set B additionally attaches an invented 'Region 3' condition to the rated generator speed and a questionable 'baseline' condition to the rated rotor speed, neither of which qualifies the values on this page. Set A keeps the conditions that do matter (fully-deployed brake torque) without adding unsupported ones. Both omit the gearbox no-frictional-losses assumption and the 5% critical damping ratio behind the driveshaft constants.
remarks: Both sets list the rated rotor speed twice (as 'Rated Rotor Speed' and as 'Rated Speed'/'rated speed'), a clear duplicate. Neither set captures the stated assumptions: gearbox with no frictional losses, and the 5% critical structural-damping ratio (free-free mode, rigid generator and rotor) that yields the spring and damping constants. Set B's 'Region 3' condition has no support anywhere on the page; 'baseline' is at best loosely traceable to 'NREL 5-MW baseline wind turbine' and is not a condition on the 12.1 rpm value.
